acknowledged.MagicContextSidebarView.header.glyph: a collapse disclosure the host owns. PRD §16 records `collapse state` as an `Atelier-owned equivalent`, and a second one drawn from the producer's glyph would put two collapse affordances on one panel. Atelier's chrome draws its own, so the glyph is dropped.
acknowledged.MagicContextSidebarView.header.version: a PRD §16 DEVIATION, not parity. The parity table lists `version | PARITY`, and the rich panel does not draw it: the sidebar protocol has no slot for a version string, and adding one would mean inventing chrome the producer does not model. Recorded so the gap is a stated decision against the PRD rather than an oversight — the Pi text sidebar drops it as well, so the two renderings agree even though the PRD says otherwise.
acknowledged.SidebarRecompStatus.bar.barText: Atelier's progress node draws its own bar from current/total. The producer's text strip is a second bar for the same number, so it is dropped rather than drawn twice.
acknowledged.SidebarViewRow.bold: Atelier's keyValue has no bold field. Faking it with ANSI does not survive cleanPanelText, so the flag is dropped and recorded as a known lossy projection.
